listing.name: Torchships and Deadly Armaments Unofficial Update
listing.summary: An unofficial update bringing Tartiflette's mod, Torchships and Deadly Armaments, to 0.98. Credit to Tartiflette as this is simply an unofficial update for one of his mods. Credit as well to Maxwell and Slavodan for the Owl (XIV) sprite added in this fork.
listing.aiSummary: Updates the Torchships and Deadly Armaments content for version 0.98, including buffs to ships like the Herald and adjustments to stats and spawn weights.

description: Provides an unofficial update for the Torchships and Deadly Armaments mod, targeting game version 0.98. It includes various balance changes such as buffing the Herald, adjusting ship variants, modifying mass and value stats, and adding new tags and hullmods.
